column4:
The metadata of our datasets are DCAT-AP compliant and therefore we have supported the search interfaces of our portal with search options and filtering criteria that allow our users to find datasets more easily along the descriptors of a DCAT-AP.

Response to Reviewer 2: 

Regarding the portal, there is a search and filtering function based on the main metadata provided for narrowing down the search results, such as: organization, topic, tags, format, etc. The search results can be further refined through free-text search as desired. These functionalities are currently satisfactory in line with national requirements. The metadata of datasets can be exported in bulk from the interface in both .xlsx and .rdf formats for any user.

* If yes, could you provide some examples of the actions taken in this regard.
column3: yes, or all public sector data providers already publish data
column4: The concrete actions are that the national open data portal  was mde public in December of 2022, furthermore according to the Act No. XCI of 2021 on the National Data Asset, which was follow up by the Government Decree No. 607/2021 (XI. 5.) on certain detailed rules related to the utilisation of national data assets- the National Data Asset Management Agency can actually contact any of the public data management body and ask for data provision.
column7:
Yes, the Act XCI on National Data Asset and the Government Decree No. 607/2021. (XI. 5.) on certain detailed rules related to the utilisation of national data assets defines the rules regarding the National Open Data Portal which is the core element of the re-use of public data. The National Data Portal was made public in December 2022.
On 13 December 2023, the Hungarian Parliament adopted a new law, Act CI of 2023 on the System for the Utilisation of National Data Assets and Certain Services, which incorporated the previous regulations, including the provisions of Act LXIII of 2012 on the Re-use of Public Data. In accordance with the new law, the National Data Asset Management Agency, as the operator of the National Data Portal, may contact any body performing public functions and ask for data provision.
In addition, the new law expands the functions of the National Open Data Portal.

As part of the planned future portal development, we will explore the possibilities of data harvesting.

column2: 2.4 Portal sustainability

Does the national portal have a strategy to ensure its sustainability?

For Explanation:
* If yes, please (1) provide the URL to this document and (2) describe the main measures to keep the portal running in the long-term and continue to serve its audience
column7:
Yes, the Act XCI of 2021 on the National Data Asset which was in effect until 31 March 2024, defines the rules regarding the National Open Data Portal as an information platform. The main actor of this process is the National Data Asset Management Agency as the maintainer of the national portal.
On 13 December 2023, the Hungarian Parliament adopted a new Act, Act CI of 2023 on the System for the Utilisation of the National Data Asset and on Certain Services, which adopted the previous rules, including the provisions of Act LXIII of 2012 on the Re-use of Public Data.
https://njt.hu/jogszabaly/2023-101-00-00.0#FEI
Hungary’s Artificial Intelligence Strategy also ensure its sustainability. https://digitalisjoletprogram.hu/publications/mi_strategy_en/#page=1
